study: Blinded eBOSS DR16 published ELG extra HEALPix bit-8 coordinate contract diagnostic
pixel_list: Extract complete literal mask_pixel assignment from byte-identical upstream source with Python AST; no hand-selected pixel subset
deterministic_probe: For every source mask pixel, use hp.pix2ang(1024,ipix,nest=False,lonlat=False) to generate theta_rad,phi_rad at its centre, then map to RA=(360-degrees(phi_rad))%360, DEC=90-degrees(theta_rad). No observed or mock galaxy/random catalogue coordinates enter.
fixed_diagnostics: Complete source mask-pixel count and SHA256 of the ordered integer array
Number of source-mask pixel centres whose reconstructed pixel matches each convention
How often upstream-as-written and radian-correct calls disagree at those centres
Exact equality of radian and equivalent degree HEALPix conventions at all fixed centres
At most first ten source-ordered differing examples with RA,DEC and returned pixels
gate: Radian and equivalent-degree implementations must agree with source pixel IDs on all source-pixel centres. If upstream-as-written differs from those implementations, record the inconsistency. Source-pixel roundtrip is a mathematical consistency test, NOT a verified official pixel mask or scientific selection.
no_silent_fix: Do not apply any candidate bit-8 selection to observed or mock galaxies, randoms or analysis window. Resolving which coordinate convention was used to generate official bitmaps/reference output is a separate source-based step.
